title: Tencent/LoopForge
lede: LoopForge is Tencent's self-hosted workspace for shipping software with coding-agent CLIs, running agents, scripts and human approval gates as repeatable workflows inside Docker sandboxes.

points: Two modes: chat with a Main Bot that opens a sandbox and delegates to project roles, or run an SOP with fixed stages and sign-off.
An SOP chains Agent, Script, Human gate, Sub-SOP and Preview nodes; a failed check can send work back to an earlier step.
Ten CLIs serve as executors, including CodeBuddy, Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and Cursor CLI, and each role picks its own.
Runs keep node status, tool traces, logs and artifacts, and can be paused, retried or rerun from any node.
LoopForge Local installs the built-in workflows into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other assistants with no server.
